description: Local AI desktop assistant for working with documents, files, and everyday tasks using models that run on your computer.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Hob Electron payload archive was not found: $payload" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mainExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Hob.exe was not found after extracting the Electron payload: $mainExe" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appAsar -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Hob resources\app.asar was not found after payload extraction.' }
notes: Hob requires at least 8 GB RAM; 16 GB is recommended for everyday tasks and 32 GB or more for its most capable models. Keep 10–25 GB of free disk space for Hob and its models, or about 75 GB for the largest model. Hob stores chats, settings, Python runtime, and downloaded models under %APPDATA%\Hob by default; these files remain after Scoop uninstall. Hob also includes an internal updater that may update application files independently of Scoop.
